releases.notes:
By @NriotHrreion

## Security

- Migrate access key hashing from MD5 to salted Bcrypt (Thanks @yeomyaloo for reporting this!)

## Fix

- Preserve vertical scrolling in sheet content on mobile (#604)

> [!NOTE]
> The minecraft version on the jar file indicates the **_minimum_** required game version

By @NriotHrreion

## Add

- Poll and refresh player ping values in dashboard and players page (#594)

## Fix

- Activity chart date labels overlaps each other on mobile (#590)
- Bundled H2 may handle other mods' database connections (#592)
- Rich-text translation interpolation has XSS issue (#598)

## Change

- Bump Pumpkin crates to `0.2.2+26.3-26.60` and bump related Rust dependencies (#595)
- Bump Javalin from `7.2.3` to `7.2.4` (#597)

> [!WARNING]
> If other plugins/mods that uses H2 database are installed on your server, you may need to migrate or reset the database after upgrading to this version. Ask your AI agent if you don't know exactly how to.

> [!NOTE]
> The minecraft version on the jar file indicates the **_minimum_** required game version

By @NriotHrreion

## Add

- Support multiple languages for entry descriptions of gamerules and `server.properties` (#588)

## Change

- Upgrade follow-redirects from `1.16.1` to `1.16.2`

> [!NOTE]
> The minecraft version on the jar file indicates the **_minimum_** required game version

By @NriotHrreion

## Fix

- Skip transparent blocks (barrier, air/cave_air/void_air, structure_void, light, glass, glass_pane) during map rendering (#576)

## Change

- Migrate form components from `<FormField />` to `<Controller />` and `<Field />` (#585)
- Raise required node versions and update Rust certificate crates (#577)
- Upgrade rustls from `0.23.5` to `0.23.46`
- Upgrade vinext from `1.3.0` to `1.4.0`
- Upgrade zip from `6.0.0` to `9.0.5`
- Upgrade zod from `3.25.67` to `4.6.6`

> [!NOTE]
> The minecraft version on the jar file indicates the **_minimum_** required game version

By @NriotHrreion

## Fix

- Handle clipboard failures on HTTP and invalid keyboard events (#567)
- Align Minecraft language keys with the stable release version of en-us (#569)

## Change

- Improve player skin viewer and support skin animation (#572)
- Upgrade minecraft-skin-viewer from `0.0.19` to `0.0.27`
- Upgrade vinext from `1.0.1` to `1.3.0`
- Upgrade react from `19.2.8` to `19.3.1`
- Upgrade @vitejs/plugin-react from `5.2.0` to `6.1.0`
- Upgrade @vitejs/plugin-rsc from `0.5.34` to `0.5.38`
- Upgrade vite from `8.2.0` to `8.3.4`
- Upgrade fast-uri from `3.1.7` to `3.1.9`
- Upgrade @humanfs/node from `0.16.6` to `0.16.8`
- Upgrade follow-redirects from `1.16.0` to `1.16.1`

> [!NOTE]
> The minecraft version on the jar file indicates the **_minimum_** required game version

By @NriotHrreion

## Fix

- Prevent dashboard overflow on wide, short viewports (#560)
- Cannot enter the panel if the server's path contains Chinese characters (#499) (#561) (_Upstream issue: https://github.com/jetty/jetty.project/issues/15869_)

## Change

- Upgrade Jetty to `12.1.14`
- Upgrade vinext to `1.0.1`
- Improve sidebar interaction (#565)
- Update thanks list (#564)

> [!NOTE]
> The minecraft version on the jar file indicates the **_minimum_** required game version

By @NriotHrreion

## Add

- Agent prompt copy feature for open-api docs (#501)
- Show average statistics for selected monitor history range (#543)
- Support resolving OSC 8 hyperlinks in terminal (#540)
- Support for Pumpkin 26.3 (#476)

## Fix

- JWT sessions is not revoked in backend when loggin out (#503)
- Inappropriate condition for determining runtime save operations (#514)
- Runtime save editing gets lost after restarting the server (#515)
- Match underline colors to terminal log text

## Change

- Redesign the entire build workflow and improved frontend prerendering, bundle size and performance (#552) (#555) (#556)
- Redesign the terminal page layout (#518)
- Replace custom WebSocket heartbeat with native auto pings (#500)
- Integrate ansi-to-html into OPanel's codebase
- Upgrade vinext to `1.0.0`
- Upgrade axios to `1.20.0`

> [!NOTE]
> The minecraft version on the jar file indicates the **_minimum_** required game version

By @NriotHrreion

## Add

- Support for Forge 26.3 (#497)
- (paper) Retrieve plugin-modified realtime motd (#491)

## Fix

- JWT is not revoked after logout (#498)

> [!NOTE]
> The minecraft version on the jar file indicates the **_minimum_** required game version

By @NriotHrreion @7884857 @hanbin2007

## Add

- Support editing armor, offhand and ender chest in inventory editor
- Container items (such as shulker boxes) visual editor
- New monitor page and more monitor items
- Extension system (#418) (#427)
- Extension developing skill for AI agents (#424)
- Cron task command syntax
- Display real-time player position in player info sheet
- Support right-dragging action in inventory editor
- Player info hover card
- Support uploading logs to [mclo.gs](https://mclo.gs)
- Configuration option for limiting map pre-rendering concurrent
- `serverRestartDelay` configuration option
- Loading hints for tasks page
- Navbar frosted glass effect

## Fix

- Map pre-rendering may cause memory leak
- (forge) `slf4j` module is conflict with Forge libraries (#383)
- Prevent duplicate cron occurrence execution (#376)
- Stale task schedule can still be rescheduled after the task is modified or removed
- (forge/neoforge) Debug log contains sensitive info of Jetty
- Clicking IP copy button in player sheet can trigger form submission
- NBT resolver can throw uncaught error and cause the frontend to crash (#404)
- Preventing item stacks from exceeding its max size (#406)
- Logs viewer cannot adjust to the page height
- Player columns cannot update immediately after enabling whitelist
- Prevent long motd from pushing dashboard info-card control buttons out (#419)
- Websocket message broadcast may block the calling thread, causing TPS decline (#429)
- Cannot clear server launch command (#431)
- Incorrect behavior of `hasChanged` state of gamerules editor

## Change

- **_BREAKING CHANGE_**: Bukkit implementations are completely migrated to Paper. **CraftBukkit and Spigot are no longer supported**
- The project is now migrated from Next.js to [vinext](https://github.com/cloudflare/vinext) (#411)
- Optimistic inventory updates and optimizations to inventory editor, making the inventory editing experience much better
- Improve frontend layout for mobile screens
- Improve zh-hk translation (#402) (#410)
- Rearranged the player control buttons, moved some control buttons into player sheet
- Improve OIDC disabled empty page
- Move toaster to page top-right
- Re-implement Fabric configuration lib and no longer using configx
- Integrate snbt-js into OPanel's codebase (_Special thanks to @myworldzycpc and the library [`myworldzycpc/snbt-js`](https://github.com/myworldzycpc/snbt-js)_) (#416)
- Upgrade axios to `1.18.0`
- Upgrade tar to `7.5.20`
- Upgrade minecraft-textures to `26.2.1` (#415)
- Upgrade item-nbt-api to `2.16.0`

> [!NOTE]
> The minecraft version on the jar file indicates the **_minimum_** required game version

By @NriotHrreion 

## Add

- Use command `/opanel start` and `/opanel stop` to enable or disable the web panel (#18)

## Fix

- (fabric) (neoforge) Config cannot be saved to file (#24)

## Change

- Some improvements to frontend UI (#21)

> [!NOTE]
> The minecraft version on the jar file indicates the **_minimum_** required game version
